अलाबुकेश्वर n. N. of a Tīrtha, SkandaP.

अलं—धन mfn. possessing sufficient wealth, Mn. viii, 162.

a: अलंघनीय — a. Insurmountable, impassable, inaccessible, beyond the reach of; त्रिदशपंरिपक्षस्यालंघनीये कृते स्वः V. 2 proof against injury; V. 4, Ki. 14. 37.
अलंघनीयता — 1 Impassableness, insurmountableness, inaccessibility; Śi. 2. 48. --2 Inviolability; respectability. --3 Authoritative or absolute rule, superiority.
अलंघनं — Not surmounting, not transgressing, not passing over or beyond.

अलंघ्य — a. 1 Not to be transgressed, overcome &c.; Śi. 3. 64. --2 Beyond the reach of, impossible to be done; Ki. 13. 7. --3 Difficult to secure or attain, unattainable; Ki. 10. 6, 13; Śi. 8. 57; ˚ता state of being proof against an attack or injury; Ki. 11. 63.

m: अलं—बल mfn. ‘equal to any power’, N. of Śiva.

a: अलंबुसा — N. of a country.

अलंबुषः — 1 Vomiting. --2 The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. --3 Prahasta, the minister of Rāvaṇa. --4 A demon killed by Ghaṭotkacha. --षा 1 N. of a nymph or of a class of nymphs. --2 A kind of plant (लज्जालु). --3 A barrier, a line of water drawn to prevent entrance ( अन्याप्रवेशार्थं दत्ता जलरेखा).

m: अलं—गामिन् mfn. (= अनुगवीन) going after or watching (as cows) in a proper manner, Pāṇ. v, 2, 15, Sch.
अलं—जीविक mfn. sufficient for livelihood, Pat.

a: अलंजरः, --जुरः — [अलं सामर्थ्यं जृणाति, जॄ-अच्, पृषो˚उत् Tv.] An earthen jar.

m: अलं-जुष See अलम्.
अलं—जुष (अलं-), mfn. sufficient, ŚBr. iii.
अलं—काल m. for -कार, ornament, Nalod.
अलं-का—˚रानुसारिणी f. N. of wk.
अलं—कार m. the act of decorating, R. ii, 40, 13, (ifc. f., R. v, 18, 6) ornament, decoration, ŚBr.; TBr. &c. (in rhetoric) an ornament of the sense or the sound (cf. अर्थाल्˚ and शब्दाल्˚)
N. of a minister of Jaya-siṃha of Kaśmir (1129-1150 A.D.; he is also called Laṅkaka)
a: अलंकारः — 1 Decoration, act of decorating or ornamenting. --2 An ornament (fig. also); अलंकारः स्वर्गस्य V. 1; अनुत्सेकः खलु विक्रमालंकारः ibid. --3 A figure of speech of which there are three kinds: --शब्द˚, अर्थ˚, and शब्दार्थ˚; शब्दार्थयोरस्थिरा ये धर्माः शोभातिशायिनः . रसादीनुपकुर्वंतोऽलंकारास्तेंऽ गदादिवत् .. S. D. 631; उपकुर्वंति लं संतंयेंऽगद्वारेण जातु चित् . हारादिवदलंकारास्तेनुप्रासोपमादयः K. P. 8. --4 The whole science of Rhetoric. --Comp. --चंद्रिका a commentary on Kuvalayānanda. --शास्त्रं the science and art of rhetoric, poetics. --सुवर्णं gold used for ornaments. --सूरः N. of a kind of meditation in Buddhism. --हीन a. unadorned.

m: अलं-कार—भाण्ड n. a jewel-box, Mṛcch.
अलं—कार—शास्त्र n. a manual or text book of rhetoric
अलं—कार—शील m. N. of a prince of the Vidyādharas, Kathās.
अलं—कार—चूडामणि m. work on rhetoric
अलं—कार—चन्द्रिका f. work on rhetoric
अलं—कार—हीन mfn. unadorned.
अलं—कार—कारिका f. work on rhetoric
अलं—कार—कौस्तुभ m. work on rhetoric
अलं—कारक m. ornament, Mn. vii, 220.
a: अलंकारकः — Ornament, decoration; Ms. 7. 220.

m: अलं—कार—माला f. work on rhetoric
अलं—कार—मञ्जरी f. work on rhetoric
अलं—कार—मुक्तावली f. work on rhetoric
अलं-कार—रत्नाकर m. N. of wk.
अलं—कार—सूर m. N. of a kind of meditation, Buddh.
अलं-कार—सर्वस्व n. N. of wk.
अलं—कार—सुवर्ण n. gold used for ornaments, L.
अलं—कार—वती f. ‘the decorated one’, N. of the ninth Lambaka in the Kathāsaritsāgara,
अलं—कार्य mfn. to be adorned or decorated, Sāh.
अलं-करण -कार &c. See अलम्.
अलं—करण n. making ready, preparation, Kauś., (ifc. f(आ). , Kathās.) decoration, ornament, KātyŚr. &c.
a: अलंकरणं — 1 Decoration, ornamenting. --2 An ornament (lit. and fig.); सृजति तावदशेषगुणाकरं पुरुषरत्नमलंकरणं भुवः Bh. 2. 92. --3 Preparation.

m: अलं—करणिन् mfn. possessed of an ornament, Kathās.
अलं—करिष्णु mfn. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 136) fond of ornament, Nir.
(with acc.) decorating, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 69, Sch., (अन्. neg. See also s.v.), Pāṇ. vi, 2, 160, Sch.
अलं—करिष्णु m. N. of Śiva.
a: अलंकरिष्णु — a. 1 Fond of ornaments. --2 Decorating, skilled in decorating. --3 Ornamented. --ष्णुः An epithet of Śiva.

m: अलं—कर्मीण mfn. competent for any act or work, Pāṇ. v, 4, 7.
अलं—कर्तृ mfn. one who decorates, L.
a: अलंकर्तृ — a. A decorator, skilled in decoration.

m: अलं—√ कृ (cf. अरं-√ कृत s.v. अरम्), to make ready, prepare, ŚBr., (ind.p. -कृत्वा, q.v.); to decorate, ornament, R. &c., (ind.p. -कृत्य, q.v.); to impede, check, violate (with gen.), Mn. viii, 16.
a: अलंकृ — {c8c} U. 1 To prepare, make ready (Ved.). --2 To ornament, decorate, grace; तत्र च शयनीयमलंचकार K. 207; कतमो वंशोऽलंकृतः Ś. 1. --3 To prevent from, impede (with gen.).

m: अलं—कृत (अलं-) mfn. adorned, decorated, ŚBr. &c.; (cf. अरं-कृत s.v. अरम्.)
अलं—कृति f. ornament, Kathās.
rhetorical ornament (cf. -कार above), Sāh.; Kāvyād.
a: अलंकृतिः — f. 1 Decoration. --2 An ornament; कर्णालंकृति Amaru. 13. --3 A rhetorical ornament, a figure of speech; तददौषौ शब्दार्थौ सगुणावनलंकृती पुनः क्वापि K. P. 1; यो विद्वान् मन्यते काव्यं शब्दार्थावनलंकृती . असौ न मन्यते कस्मादनुष्णमनलं कृती ..; Chandr. 1; सालंकृतिः श्रंवणकोमलवर्णराजिः Bv. 3. 6 (where अ˚ has senses 2. and 3.).

m: अलं—कृत्वा ind.p. having made ready, having prepared, Pāṇ. i, 4, 64, Sch.
अलं—कृत्य ind.p. having decorated, TBr.; Mn. iii, 28 and v, 68.
अलं—क्रिया f. decorating, L.
rhetorical ornament.
a: अलंक्रिया — Adorning, ornamenting, decoration (fig. also); प्रशमस्तस्य भवत्यलंक्रिया Ki. 2. 32.

m: अलं—कुमारि mfn. fit for marrying a young girl, Pat.
अलं—मनस् mfn. satisfied in mind, BhP. (cf. अरमणस् s.v. अरम्.)
अलं—पूर्व mfn. being preceded by the word अलम्, Pat.
अलं—पशु mfn. able to keep cattle, KātyŚr.

a: अलंपट — a. Not libidinous, chaste. --टः Women's apartments.

m: अलं—प्रजनन mfn. (cf. अलं प्रजायाः above s.v. अलम्) able to beget or generate, ĀśvŚr.
अलं—पुरुषीण mfn. sufficient for a man, Pāṇ. v, 4, 7.
अलं-तम -तराम्. See अलम्.
अलं—तम mfn. very well able to (Inf.), BhP.
अलं—तराम् ind. (compar. of अलं) exceedingly, Kum. xiv, 16 and xv, 28
very much better or easier to (Inf.), Śiś. ii, 106.

inviolable (as a command or prohibition), BhP.

अलकं — ind. In vain, for nothing.

m: अलम् ind. (later form of अरम्, q.v.), enough, sufficient, adequate, equal to, competent, able. (अलम् may govern a dat. [जीवितवै (Ved. Inf. dat.) अलम्, AV. vi, 109, 1, or अलं जीवनाय, Mn. xi, 76, &c., sufficient for living] or Inf. [Pāṇ. ii, 4, 66; अलं विज्ञातुम् ‘able to conceive’, Nir. ii, 3] or instr. [Pāṇ. ii, 3, 27; Siddh.; अलं शङ्कया, enough i.e. away with fear!] or gen. [अलं प्रजायाः, capable of obtaining progeny, PBr.] or may be used with the fut. [अलं हनिष्यति, he will be able to kill, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 154, Sch.] or with an ind. [Pāṇ. iii, 4, 18; अलं भुक्त्वा, enough of eating i.e. do not eat more, अलं विचार्य, enough of consideration].)
a: अलम् — ind. [अल्-बाहु˚ अम्] 1 (a) Enough, sufficient for, adequate to (with dative or inf.); तस्यालमेषा क्षुधितस्य तृप्त्यै R. 2. 39; Ku. 6. 82; अन्यथा प्रातराशाय कुर्याम त्वामलं वयम् Bk. 8. 98; Śi. 2. 40, 106, 110; K. 133; Bh. 3. 22; Ms. 11. 77; R. 2. 39, 9. 32; 15. 64; Me. 64, 88. (b) A match for, equal to (with dat.); दैत्येभ्यो हरिरलं Sk.; अलं मल्लो मल्लाय Mbh. --2 Able, competent (with inf.); अलं भोक्तुं Sk.; वरेण शमितं लोकानलं दग्धुं हि तत्तपः Ku. 2. 56; V. 3. 10; with loc. also; त्रयाणामपि लोकानामलमस्मि निवारणे Rām. --3 Away with, enough of, no need of, no use of (having a prohibitive force), with instr. or gerund; अलमन्यथा गृहीत्वा M. 1. 20; अलमलं बहु विकत्थ्य M. 1; आलप्यालमिदं बभ्रोर्यत्स दारानपाहरत् Śi. 2. 40; अलं महीपाल तव श्रमेण R. 2. 34; Ku. 5. 82; अलमियद्भिः कुसुमैः Ś. 4 so many flowers will do; Śi. 10. 75; sometimes used, though less correctly, with the inf. in the same sense; अलमात्मानं खेदयितुं Ve. 2, 3; अलं सुप्तजनं प्रबोधयितुं Mk. 3. --4 (a) Completely, thoroughly; अर्हस्येनं शमयितुमलं वारिधारासहस्रैः Me. 53; त्वमपि विततयज्ञः स्वर्गिणः प्रीणयालम् Ś. 7. 34; R. 10. 80; K. 169; Śi. 3. 58; 4. 39. (b) Greatly, excessively, to a high degree; तुदंति अलम् K. 2; यो गच्छत्यलं विद्विषतः प्रति Ak.; Mv. 6. 40; इत्यलमन्वशान् मुनिर्मां Ki. 13. 13 again and again, pressingly. --5 In vain. --6 Surely, verily. --7 In the sense of अस्ति and भूषण also. --Comp. --कर्मीण a. [अलं समर्थः कर्मणे ख] competent to do any act; skilful, clever. --कुमारि a. [अलं कुमार्यै] sufficient to support a maiden (धनं); P. I. 2. 44. --कृ, --कार &c. see separately below. --गामिन् a. [अलं पर्याप्तं गच्छति, णिनि] going after, following in due or proper manner; P. V. 2. 15. --जीविक a. [अलं जीविकायै चत.] sufficient for livelihood. --जुष a. [अलंजुष्यते कर्मणि बाहु˚ क] sufficient, adequate to eating. --तम a. able, sufficient, having power. --धन a. [अलं प्रभूतं धनमस्त्यस्य अच्] possessing sufficient wealth, rich; निरादिष्टधनश्चेत्तु प्रतिभूः स्यादलंधनः Ms. 8. 162. --धूम a. [अलमत्यर्थो धूमः] thick smoke, volume of smoke. --पशुः [अलं यज्ञे निरर्थः पशुः] a bad or useless animal (for sacrifice). (--a.) able to keep cattle. --पुरुषीण a. [अलं समर्थं पुरुषाय; स्वार्थेख] {1} fit for a man, becoming a man. {2} sufficient for a man. --(णः) a man who is chief of the opposite warriors in a battle. --बल a. {1} strong enough, having sufficient power. {2} an epithet of Śiva. --बुद्धिः {1} sufficient sense. {2} false notion ( मिथ्याबुद्धि). --भूष्णु a. [अलं सामर्थ्ये भू-ग्स्नु] able, competent; विनाप्यस्मदलंभूष्णुरिज्यायै तपसः सुतः Śi. 2. 9.

SvetArkavfkzaH । SAdA Akanda iti BAzA । (asya paryyAyAntaraM guRAntaraYca yaTA -- “alarko guRarUpaH syAnmandAro vasukopi ca । SvetapuzpaH sadApuzpaH sabAlArkaH pratApasaH ॥ rakto'paro'rkanAmA syAdarkaparRo vikIraRaH । raktapuzpaH SuklaPalastaTAsPowaH prakIrttitaH ॥ arkadvayaM saraM vAtakuzWakaRqUvizavraRAn । nihanti plIhagulmArSaHSlezmodaraSakftkrimIn ॥ alarkakusumaM vfzyaM laGudIpanapAcanaM । arocakaprasekArSaHkAsaSvAsanivAraRam” ॥ iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ “duzwakarddamasaMsparSAH kaRqUkledAnvitAntarAH” । aNgulyo'lasa mityAhuH ॥ iti vABawaH ॥) tatparyyAyaH । pratApasaH 2 rAjArkaH 3 gaRarUpI 4 । iti ratnamAlAmarO ॥ SUkarAkArAzwapAdatIkzRadantasUcyAkftilomajantuviSezaH । daMSanAmAsuro BfguSApAt ayaM janturBUtvA karRasyoruM BittvA paraSurAmadfzwipAtAt SApamuktaH pUrvvarUpo baBUva । iti mahABArate rAjaDarmme ॥ (“dadarSa rAmastaM cApi kfmiM SUkarasanniBaM । azwapAdaM tIkzRadaMzwraM sUcIBiriva saMvftaM ॥ romaBiH saMnirudDANgamalarkaM nAma nAmataH । so'bravIdahamAsaM prAgdaMSo nAma mahAsuraH । purA devayuge tAta ! BfgostulyavayA iva । so'haM BfgoH sudayitAM BAryyAmapaharaM balAt ॥ maharzeraBiSApena kfmiBUto'pataM Buvi” । svanAmaKyAto nfpatiH । “SEvyaH SenakapotIye svamAMsaM pakziRe dadO । alarkaScakzuzI datvA jagAma gatimuttamAm” ॥ iti rAmAyaRe । svanAmaKyAtaH kASirAjaH, sa hi vatsarAjasya puttraH sannateSca pitA, yaTA harivaMSe, -- “vatsaputtrastvalarkastu sannatistasya cAtmajaH । alarkaH kASirAjastu brahmaRyaH satyasaNgaraH ॥ zazwiM varzasahasrARi zazwiM varzaSatAni ca । tasyAsIt sumahadrAjyaM rUpayOvanaSAlinaH” .)
v: pu॰ alamarkate'rcyate vA arka--ac arca--GaY vA Saka॰ । 1 SvetArkavfkze 2 kziptakukkare 3 kfmiBede ca sa ca BA॰ SA॰ pa॰ darSitaH yaTA “aTa kfmiH SlezmamedomAMsaSoRitaBIjanaH । dAruRo dAruRasparSaH karRasyAByAsamAgataH । sa॰ tasyorumaTAsAdya biBeda ruDirASanaH । na cEnamaSakat kzeptuM hantuM vApi gurorBayAt । sa daSyamAnastu taTA kfmiRA tena BArata! । guroH praboDanASaNkI tamupEkzata sUryyajaH । karRastu vedanAM DEryyAdasahyAM vinigfhya tAm । akamprayannavyaTayan DArayAmAsa BArgavam । tadAsya ruDireRANgaM parispfzwaM BfgUdvahaH । tadA'buDyata tejasvI santrastaScedamabravIt । aho'smyaSucitAmprAptaH kimidaM kriyate tvayA । kaTayasva BayaM tyaktvA yATAtaTyamidaM mama । tasya karRRastadAcazwa kfmiRA pariBakzaRam । dadarSa rAmastaM cApi kfmiM SUkarasanniBam । azwapAdantIkzRadaMzwraM sUciBiriva saMvftam । romaBiH sannirudDANgamalarkaM nAma nAmataH । saM dfzwamAtro rAmeRa kfmiH prARAnavAsfjat । tasminnevAsfji klinnastadadButamivABavat । tato'ntarIkze dadfSe viSvarUpaH karAlavAn । rAkzaso lohitagrIvaH kfzRANgo meGavAhanaH । sa rAmaM prAYjalirBUtvA baBAze pUrRamAnasaH । svasti te BfguSArdUla । gamizyAmi yaTAgatam । mokzito narakAdasmAdBavatA munisattama! । BadraYca te'stu vande tvAM priyaM me BavatA kftam । tamuvAca mahAbAhurjAmadagnyaH pratApavAn । kastvaM kasmAcca narakaM pratipanno bravIhi tat । so'bravodahamAsaM prAgdaMSo nAma mahAsuraH । purA devayuge tAta! BfgostulyavayA iva । so'haM BfgoH sudayitAM BAryyAmapaharaM balAt । maharzeraBiSApena kfmiBUto'pataM Buvi । abravIdDi sa mAM kroDAttava pUrvvapitAmahaH । mUtraSlezmASanaH pApa nirayaM pratipatsyase । SApasyAnto BavedbrahmannityevaM tamaTAbruvam । BavitA BArgavAdrAmAditi mAmabravIdBfguH” ।
m: अलर्क m. a mad dog or one rendered furious, Suśr.
a fabulous animal, like a hog with eight legs, MBh.; R.; MārkP.
the plant Calotropis Gigantea Alba, Suśr. (cf. दीर्घालर्क)
N. of a king, Hariv. &c.
a: अलर्कः — 1 A mad dog or one rendered furious. --2 A fabulous animal like a hog with eight legs. --3 A kind of worm. --4 N. of a plant (श्वेतार्क).

k.v: मन्दारश्चार्कपर्णोऽत्र शुक्लेऽलर्कप्रतापसौ। शिवमल्ली पाशुपत एकाष्ठीलो बुको वसुः॥
शुनको भषकः श्वा स्यादलर्कस्तु स योगितः। श्वा विश्वकद्रुर्मृगयाकुशलः सरमा शुनी॥

m: अलर्ति (3. sg.) and अलर्षि (2. sg.), Intens. fr. √ ऋ, q.v.
अलर्षि-राति mfn. eager to bestow, SV. (v.l. अन्-अर्श-राति, q.v., RV.)
अ-लस् mfn. (√ लस्), not shining, L.
a: अलस् — a. Not shining.

s: strI, (lasa + ac, tato naYsamAsaH, striyAM wAp .) haMsapadIlatA । iti medinI ॥ haMsapadISabde'sya guRAdayo jYeyAH ॥
m: अ-लसा (आ), f. the climbing plant Vitis Pedata Wall, L.
अलसाला f. ? AV. vi, 16, 4.
अलसी-√ भू to become tired, Bhpr.

s: tri, (na lasati vyApriyate, lasa + ac .) AlasyayuktaH । AlsyA iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । mandaH 2 tundaparimfjaH 3 AlasyaH 4 SItakaH 5 anuzRaH 6 । ityamaraH ॥ SItalaH 7 kuRWaH 8 muKanirIkzakaH 9 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (kriyAmandaH । kriyAjaqaH । avaSyakarttavyezu apravfttiSIlaH । “avyavasAyinamalasaM dEvaparaM sAhasAcca parihInaM । pramadeva vfdDapatiM necCatyupagfhItuM lakzmIH” । iti hitopadeSe .)

puM, (lasa + ac, tato naYsamAsaH .) vfkzaviSezaH । pAdarogaBedaH । iti medinI ॥ pA~kui iti BAzA । tasya nidAnarUpe । “klinnANgalyantarO pAdO kaRqUdAharujAnvitO । duzwakarddamasaMsparSAdalasaM taM viBAvayet” ॥ alasaM kAdaI iti loke । aTa tasya cikitsA । “pAdO sitkAranAlena lepanaM tvalase hitaM । pawolakunawInimbarocanAmaricEstilEH ॥ kzudrAsvarasasidDena kawutElena lepayet । tataH kAsIsakunawItilacUrRErvvicUrRayet” ॥ avaDUlayet । “karaYjavIjaM rajanI kAsIsaM padmakaM maDu । rocanA haritAlaYca lepo'yamalase hitaH” ॥ iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ (“wuzwakarddamasaMsparSAH kaRqUkledAnvitAntarAH । aNgulyo'lasamityAhuH” ॥ iti vABawaH ॥)
v: tri॰ na lasati vyApriyate lasa--ac । avaSyakarttavyezu SarIrApAwavamaBinIya 1 kftAprayAse, “mfdutaratanavo'lasAH prakftyAH” mAGaH ayuktaH prAkftaH stabDaH SaWo nEkftiko'lasaH । 2 kriyAmande ca (pAku~i) 3 pAdarogaBede, 4 vfkzaBede ca pu॰ । 5 haMsapadIlatAyAM strI । pAdarogo yaTA “klinnANgulyantarO pAdO kaRqUdAharujAnvitO । duzwakardama saMsparSAdalasaM ca viBAvaya” pAdO siktvAranAlena lepanaM hyalase hitam” iti ca SuSrutaH । gargAdigaRapAWAt 4 muniBede tataH apatye yaY AlasyastadapatyelohitA॰ yUni zPa AlasyAyanaH । alasasya BAvaH zyaY । Alasyam na॰ tal alasatA strI tva alasatvaM na॰ । kriyAkaraRAya aprayatne ।
m: अ-लस mf(आ)n. inactive, without energy, lazy, idle, indolent, tired, faint, ŚBr.; AitBr. &c.
अ-लस (अस्), m. a sore or ulcer between the toes, Suśr.
(= अ-लसक below) tympanitis, Bhpr.
N. of a small poisonous animal, Suśr.
N. of a plant, L.
a: अलस — a. [न लसति व्याप्रियते, लस्-अच्] 1 Inactive, without energy, lazy, idle, indolent. --2 Tired, fatigued, languid; मार्गश्रमादलसशरीरे दारिके M. 5; Amaru. 4, 90; खेदालसेव K. 143, 197, 211, 62, 98; Śi. 8. 7; V. 3. 2; Dk. 20, Śi. 13. 48; 9. 39; U. 1. 24; Ki. 10. 60, V. 5; गमनमलसं Māl. 1. 17. --3 Soft, gentle. --4 Slow, dull (as in gait or motion); श्रोणीभारादलसगमना Me. 82; तस्याः परिस्फुरितगर्भभरालसायाः U. 3. 28. --सः 1 A sore or ulcer between the toes. --2 A kind of tree. --3 N. of a sage. --4 N. of a small poisonous animal. --सा N. of a plant (हंसपदी). --Comp. --ईक्षणा a woman with languishing looks.

k.v: पराचितपरिस्कन्दपरजातपरैधिताः। मान्दस्तुन्दपरिमृज आलस्यः शीतकोऽलसोऽनुष्णः॥

m: अ-लस—गमन mf(आ)n. going lazily, Megh.

s: puM, (na lasyati anena, lasa + karaRe vun .) udararogaviSezaH । iti mADavakaraH ॥ tasya rUpaM “kukzirAnahyate'tyarTaM pratAmyet parikUjati । nirudDo mArutaScEva kukzAvupari DAvati ॥ vAtavarcconiroDASca yasyAtyarTaM Bavedapi । tasyAlasakamAcazwe tfzRodgArO tu yasya ca” ॥ tantrAntare । “prayAti nordDvaM nADastAdAhAro na ca pacyate । AmASaye'lasIBUtastena so'lasakaH smftaH” ॥ asya lakzaRaM cikitsA ca ajIrRaSabde drazwavyA ॥ (alasakamupadekzyAmaH । durbbalasyAlpAgnerbahuSlezmaRo vAtamUtrapurIzavegaviDAriRaH sTiragurubahurUkza SItaSuzkAnnasevinastadannapAnamanilaprapIqitaM SlezmaRA ca vibadDamArgamatimAtrapralInamalasatvAnna vahirmuKI Bavati । tataSCardyatIsAravarjyAnyAmapradozaliNgAnyaBidarSayati atimAtrARi । atimAtrapraduzwASca dozAH praduzwAmabadDamArgAstiryyagAgacCantaH kadAcit kevalamevAsya SarIraM daRqavat stamBayanti । tatastamalasakamasADyaM bruvate । virudDADyaSanAjIrRASanaSIlinaH punareva dozamAmavizamityAcakzate Bizajo vizasadfSaliNgatvAt । tatparamasADyamASukAritvAt virudDopakramatvAcceti । tatra sADyamAmaM praduzwamalasIBUtamulleKayet । pAyayitvA salavaRamuzRavAri । tataH svedanavarttipraRiDAnAByAmupAcaredupavAsayeccEnam । iti carakaH ॥)
v: pu॰ na lasyati anena lasa karaRe--bA॰ vun । 1 rogaBede । yaTAha suSrutaH “ajIrRRamAmaM vizwabDaM vidagDaM ca yadIritam । visUcyalasakO tasmAdBavetAm” ityupakramya “kukzirAnahyate'tyarTaM tAmyatyatyarTaM ca kUjati । nirudDomAru tovApi kukzAvupari DAvati । vAtavarconiroDaSca yasyA tyarTaM Bavedapi । tasyAlasakamAcazwe tfzRodgArO ca yasya tu” । tanniruktirapi anyatra darSitA “prayAti nordDaM nADastAdAhAro na ca pacyate । AmASayo'lasIBUtastena so'lasakaH smftaH” । alasa + svArTe kan । 2 alasa SabdArTe tri॰ ।
m: अ-लसक m. tympanitis, flatulence (intumescence of the abdomen, with constipation and wind), Car.; Suśr.
a: अलसक — a. Indolent, idle. --कः Flatulence, intumescence of the abdomen, with constipation and wind; प्रयाति नोर्ध्वं नाधस्तादाहारो न च पच्यते . आमाशयोऽलसीभूतस्तेन सोऽलसकः स्मृतः ..

m: अ-लस—ता, f. or अ-लस—त्व, n. idleness.
अलसय Nom. ˚यति, to slacken, relax (trans.), Subh.

s: strI, (alase IkzaRe yasyAH sA .) strIviSezaH । sA alasadfzwiyuktA । iti hemacandraH ॥

m: अलसेक्षण mf(आ)n. having languishing or tired looks, Rājat.

a: अलस्य — a. Idle, lazy.

v: pu॰ ala--vA atic । gItimAtfkAyAm svarasADanArTe sArigAmAdisvaraBede tadupakrameREva hi gIteH prAramBAttezAM gItimAtfkAtvam ।
m: अलति m. a kind of song, L.
a: अलतिः — [अल्-बा˚ अतिच्] Commencement of the notes of a song.

m: अ-लतिका f. a soil destitute of creeping plants, Kām.

s: klI, (lavamAlAti, lA + ka, tato naYsamAsaH .) AlavAlaM । vfkzamUle jalaDAraRArTakftAliH । cAramAdA iti KyAtaH । ityamarawIkAyAM BaratAdayaH ॥
m: अलवाल or अलवालक, m. = आलवाल, q.v., L.
a: अलवालं — A basin for water at the root of a tree; see आलवाल.

s: klI, (alavAla eva, alavAla + svArTe kan .) AlavAlaM । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥

m: अ-लव—˚णाशिन् mfn. not eating salt food, ŚrS.
अ-लवण mfn. not salty, Pāṇ. v, 1, 121.
अलवस् See 2. अलि.

v: pu॰ na layaH viroDe na॰ ta॰ । 1 layaviroDini udBave । “SakrAdizvapi lokezu SrUyamARO layAlayO” rAmA॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । 2 vinASABAve । nAsti layoyasyA 3 avasTAnaSUnye BramaRaSIle “svAnamAnamati kAlimAlayA” mAGaH “layo layanaM kvacidavasTAnaM nAsti yasyAH” malli॰ 4 vinASaSUnye ca tri॰ ।
m: अ-लय m. (√ ली), non-dissolution, permanence, R. iii, 71, 10 (v.l. अन्-अय)
अ-लय mfn. restless, Śiś. iv, 57.
a: अलय — a. [नास्ति लयः अवस्थानं यस्य] 1 Houseless, vagrant, moving about; Śi. 4. 57. --2 Without destruction or loss, imperishable. --यः 1 Nondestruction, {{permanance->permanence||20210122|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48|}}. --2 Birth, production.

m: अलयस् See 2. अलि
अले or अलेले ind. (cf. अरे and अरेरे), unmeaning words in the dialect of the demons or Piśācas (introduced in plays &c.), L.
a: अले — ind. Unmeaning words in the dialect of the Piśācas chiefly introduced in plays.

m: अ-लेशैज mfn. ‘not moving a bit’, firm, steady, L.
a: अलेशैज — a. Firm, steady.

m: अ-लेश mfn. not little, much, large
a: अलेश — a. Not little, much, large. --शं ind. Not at all.

m: अ-लेश्˚अम् ind. ‘not a bit’, not at all, L.

a: अलेले — ind. Unmeaning words in the dialect of the Piśācas chiefly introduced in plays.

m: अ-लेप m. = prec. [अलून no remnant or remaining particles], IndSt.
अ-लेप mfn. unstained, clean, pure, MBh.

v: tri॰ nAsti lepaH saMbanDoyasya vA kap । nissambanDe parAtmani pu॰ । lipa--Rvul na॰ ta॰ । lepakaBinne tri॰ ।
m: अ-लेपक mfn. stainless.
a: अलेपक — a. Stainless. --कः An epithet of the Supreme Spirit.

m: अल्ग औ, m. du. the groin, VS. xxv, 6.
अल्गण्डु v.l. for अलाण्डु (q.v.).

s: puM, strI, (alati daMSe samarTo Bavati yaH, saH, ala + in .) BramaraH । (“alipaNktiranekaSastvayA, guRakftye Danuzo niyojitA” । iti kumArasamBave । “anugatamalivfndErgaRqaBittIrvihAya” । iti raGuvaMSe .) vfScikaH । ityamaraH ॥ kAkaH । kokilaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ madirA । iti medinI ॥ (vfScikarASiH .)
v: pu॰ alati daMSe, kUjite, Sabdite, vA samarTo Bavati ala--in । 1 bhramare, “alamaleriva ganDarasAvamU” mAGaH । “SyAmIBUtAH kusumasamUhe'lInAm” “maNkzUdapAti pawalEralInAm” iti ca mAGaH “alipaNktIramekaSastvayA” kumA॰ । 2 vfScike, 3 kAke, 4 kokile, 5 vfScikarASO ca sa ca dvAdaSaDA viBaktarASicakrasyAzwamo BAgaH viSAKAdyapAdAmurAGAjyezWArUpaH । 6 surAyAM ca ।
m: 1. अलि m. (for अलिन्, fr. अल, q.v.) ‘possessed of a sting’, a (large black) bee, Ragh. &c.
a scorpion, L.
a crow, L.
the Indian cuckoo, L.
spirituous liquor, L.
2. अलि m. (in the Apabhraṃśa dialect) for अरि, enemy (pl. अलयस् for अरयस्), Pat.
also अलवस् is mentioned as a corrupt pronunciation for अरयस्, ŚBr.
a: अलिः — [अल्-इन् Uṇ. 4. 138] 1 A black bee. --2 A scorpion. --3 A crow. --4 The (Indian) cuckoo. --5 The sign of the zodiac called वृश्चिक. --6 Spirituous liquor. --Comp. --कुलं a flight or number of bees; ˚संकुल full of a swarm of bees; अलिकुलसंकुलकुसुमनिराकुलनवदलमालतमाले Gīt. 1.; ˚संकुलः the kubja plant. --जिह्वा, --ह्विका [अलिरिव क्षुद्रा जिह्वा] the uvula, soft. palate. --दूर्वा N. of a plant (मालादूर्वा). --पत्रिका, --पर्णी N. of a tree ( वृश्चिकपत्राख्यवृक्षः). --प्रिय a. pleasing to the bees. --(यः) the red lotus. --(या) the trumpet flower. --माला a flight of bees. --मोदा N. of a plant (गणिकारी). --विरावः, --रुतं song or hum of a bee. --वल्लभः = ˚प्रिय q. v.

k.v: वृश्चिकः शूककीटः स्यादलिद्रुणौ तु वृश्चिके। पारावतः कलरवः कपोतोऽथ शशादनः॥
मधुव्रतो मधुकरो मधुलिण्मधुपालिनः। द्विरेफपुष्पलिड्भृङ्गषट्पदभ्रमरालयः॥

m: अलिंश m. a kind of demon, AV. viii, 6, 1.
a: अलिंशः — Ved. A kind of demon.

अलिंदः — [अल्यते भूष्यते, अल्-कर्मणि-किंदच्] 1 A terrace before a housedoor; मुखालिंदतोरणं M. 5, Dk. 74. --2 A place (like a square) at the door. --3 (pl.) N. of a country or its inhabitants; or its ruler also.
अलिंग — a. 1 Having no characteristic marks, having no marks. --2 Having bad marks. --3 (In gram.) Having no gender. --गः An epithet of the Supreme Being. --गं Absence of marks.
अलिंगिन् — m. An impostor, a pretended ascetic.
अलिंजरः — A water-jar; see अलंजर.
अलिंपक --बक — see अनिमक.

v: tri॰ nAsti liNgaM jYApakahetuScihnaM vA yasya । 1 anumApakahetuSUnye 2 cihnaSUnye ca । vedAntimatasidDe paramAtmani pu॰ । na॰ ta॰ । liNgaBinne 3 ananumApake tacca sAMKyamate “hetumadanityamavyApi sakriyamanekamASritam liNgam । sAvayavaM paratantraM vyaktaM viparItamavyaktam” sA॰ kA॰ uktamavyaktam । “akAryyaM nityaM vyApi akriyam ekamanASritamaliNgamanavayavaM svatantramavyaktamiti” sA॰ ta॰ kO॰ । tadDi na kasyApi liNgam kAryyeRa kAraRAnumAnamiha vivakzitaM tena saMhatyakAritvena parArTatayA tasya puruzAnumAkatve'pi na kzatiriti ca tatrAnusanDeyam “tadaliNgamekadravyatvAt karmmaRaH” vE॰ sU॰ । “karmma na tAvat samavAyikAraRatayA AkASamanumApayati karmmaRa ekadravyatvAt ekamAtramUrttasamavAyikAraRatvAt” vE॰ sU॰ u॰ । 4 duzwacihneca ।

Up. --4 Young. --5 Seldom, rare. --ल्पं Very little. --ल्पं, --ल्पेन, --ल्पात् adv. 1 A little. --2 For a slight reason; प्रीतिरल्पेन भिद्यते Rām. --3 Easily, without much trouble or difficulty. --Comp. --अल्प a. very little or minute, little by little; Ms. 7. 129; ˚भासं Me. 81. --असु = ˚प्राण q. v. --आकांक्षिन् a. desiring little, contented or satisfied with little. --आयुस् a. shortlived; Ms. 4. 157. (--युः m.) {1} a young one, cub. {2} a goat. --आरंभः a small or gradual beginning. --आहार, --आहारिन् a. eating little, moderate in diet, abstemious. --(रः) taking little food, moderation, abstinence in food. --इच्छु a. moderate in wishes, seeking little. --इतर a. {1} other than small, large. {2} other than few, many; as ˚राः कल्पनाः many or various ideas. --ईशाख्य a. named after an insignificant chief or master, of low origin. --ऊन a. slightly defective, not quite complete. --उपायः small means. --कार्यं a small matter. --केशी {1} N. of a plant ( भूतकेशी). {2} the root of a sweet flag. --क्रीत a. bought for a small sum, cheap. --गंध a. having little scent or odour. --(धं) a red lotus. --चेष्टित a. inert. --छद, --छाद a. scantily clad, Mk. 1. 37. --ज्ञ a. knowing little, shallow, superficial, --तनु a. {1} of short stature, dwarfish, short. {2} weak, thin. {3} having small bones. --(नुः) a kind of tree. --दक्षिण a. defective in presents (as a ceremony), not liberal in sacrificial gifts; Ms. 11. 39-40. --दृंष्टि a. narrow-minded, short-sighted. --धन a. of little wealth, not affluent or rich, poor; Ms. 3. 66; 11. 40. --धी a. weak-minded, having little sense, foolish. --पत्रः {1} N. of a plant (a species of the Tulasi). {2} a tree having a few leaves. --पद्मं a red lotus. --पशु a. Ved. having a small number of cattle. --प्रजस् a. having few descendants or subjects. --प्रभाव a. of small weight or consequence, insignificant, unimportant; ˚त्वं insignificance. --प्रमाण, --प्रमाणक a. {1} of little weight or measure. {2} of little authority, resting on little evidence. (--णः, --णकः) common cucumber. --प्रयोग a. of rare application or use, rarely used. --प्राण, --असु a. having little power or strength, having short breath, asthmatic; ˚णश्च क्रियासु भवति Suśr. --(णः) {1} slight breathing or weak aspiration. {2} (in gram.) a name given to the unaspirated letters of the alphabet (in pronouncing which little effort is required); अयुग्मा वर्गयमगा यणश्चाल्पासवः स्मृताः Sk. i. e. the vowels, semivowels, nasals and the letters क् च् ट् त् प् ग् ज् ड् द् ब्. --बल a. weak, feeble, having little strength. --बाध a. causing little annoyance or inconvenience, not very harmful. --बुद्धि --मति a. weak-minded, unwise, silly, ignorant; Ms. 12. 74. --भषिन् a. speaking little, taciturn. --मध्यम a. slender-waisted. --मात्रं {1} a little, a little merely. {2} a short time, a few moments. --मारिषः [अल्पः मारिषः शाक˚ कर्म˚] a kind of amaranth (शाक) Amaranthus Polygamus. --मूर्ति a. small-bodied, diminutive, dwarfish. (--र्तिः f.) a small figure or object. --मूल्य a. of small value, cheap. --मेधस् a. of little understanding, ignorant, silly. --वयस् a. young in age, youthful. --वादिन् a. speaking little, taciturn. --विद्य a. ignorant, illtaught, uneducated. --विषय a. {1} of limited range or capacity; क्व चाल्पविषया मतिः R. 1. 2. {2} engaged in trifling matters. --शक्ति a. of little strength, weak, feeble. --शमी a small tree like शमी. --सरस् n. a basin, a small pond (one which is shallow or dry in hot seasons).
